callouts.title: 积分单调性1
callouts.body: 如果函数在$\Omega$上满足$f\geq g$几乎处处成立，那么其积分有不等式$$\int_{\Omega}f\,d\mu \geq \int_{\Omega}g\,d\mu $$

if_problem.statement_en: If functions satisfy $f \geq g$ almost everywhere on $\Omega$, then their integrals satisfy $$\int_{\Omega} f\,d\mu \geq \int_{\Omega} g\,d\mu.$$

callouts.title: 非负函数积分非负
callouts.body: $h:\Omega \to \mathbb{R}$是几乎处处非负可测的，那么其积分也是非负的。

classification_result.english_title: Integral of a Nonnegative Function Is Nonnegative

if_problem.statement_en: If $h:\Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ is measurable and nonnegative almost everywhere, then its integral is also nonnegative.
key_techniques: definition of the Lebesgue integral for nonnegative functions

callouts.title: 反例1
callouts.body: 函数$f>g$在某个零测度的集合$E$上成立，两个函数在$E^c$上均为0.

if_problem.statement_en: Consider functions such that $f>g$ holds on a null set $E$, and both functions are $0$ on $E^c$.
key_techniques: construct functions differing only on a null set
use invariance of the integral under almost everywhere equality

callouts.title: 正测度集合上积分单调性严格成立
callouts.body: 在测度为正的可测集合$E$上函数$h>0$几乎处处成立(E上不满足此不等式的集合的测度为0),那么$$\int_E h \,d\mu > 0$$

classification_result.english_title: Strict Monotonicity of the Integral on a Positive Measure Set

if_problem.statement_en: If $h>0$ almost everywhere on a measurable set $E$ with positive measure, then $$\int_E h\,d\mu > 0.$$
key_techniques: strict positivity on a positive measure set
decompose into level sets such as $\{h \ge 1/n\}$

callouts.title: 非负函数积分为0，函数在此集上几乎处处为0
callouts.body: 在sigma-finite的测度空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上，对于非负可测函数$f$，在一个测度为正的集合$E$上的积分$\int_{E}f\,d\mu=0$那么$f =0$在集合$E$上几乎处处成立。

classification_result.english_title: If the Integral of a Nonnegative Function Is Zero, Then the Function Is Zero Almost Everywhere on the Set

if_problem.statement_en: On a sigma-finite measure space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$, let $f$ be a nonnegative measurable function. If on a measurable set $E$ of positive measure one has $\int_E f\,d\mu=0$, then $f=0$ almost everywhere on $E$.
key_techniques: contrapositive using strict positivity of the integral
